deadline.value: January 1 deadline for Ph.D. applications for Fall admission
deadline.quote: January 1 for both full-time M.S. and Ph.D. applications for Fall admission.

gre_general.value: GRE is waived for all applicants to MS and PhD programs.
gre_general.quote: 1.3.1 GRE GRE is waived for all applicants, to both MS and PhD programs.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Biomedical Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to communicate with a potential major advisor at submission.
supervisor.quote: All applicants must put the name of their preferred faculty advisor on their application, and applicants are encouraged to communicate directly with a potential major advisor at the time of the graduate application submission.

funding.value: Financial support is offered through research and teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: 2.0 FINANCIAL SUPPORT Financial support (graduate assistantship) is offered in the Biomedical Engineering Graduate Program through research and teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from accredited bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: You must hold a bachelor's degree from a degree-granting institution accredited by a U.S.
